clips.title: The story
paras: At the ruined Whelgar Excavation Site, Ormer Ironbraid sends you after the raptors that drove out his expedition. With the smaller scouts culled, he wants the Mottled Scytheclaws and Razormaws killed.

Ormer Ironbraid turns your blades on the adult raptors in the lower dig. You have already thinned the smaller juveniles that overran the upper camp, but Mottled Scytheclaws and Razormaws still threaten any hope of reclaiming the excavation. They tear through dwarven prospectors and leave the trenches strewn with shattered crates and abandoned picks.

Raptors have made their nests in the excavation pits. From the ridge above the dig, Ormer directs you into the mud to strike at the mature beasts. Prospector Whelgar and his crew hope to salvage ancient relics, but Ormer is consumed by vengeance. He demands a heavy toll of dead Scytheclaws and Razormaws before he turns to the site's apex terror.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now it's time to really make those dreaded Raptors regret their blood-thirst. Just down below there are scores of Mottled Scytheclaws and Mottled Razormaws. Make those rotten creatures pay by slaying 10 of each!

clips.title: Progress
paras: I want to make those Mottled Scytheclaws and Mottled Razormaws pay for what they did. Have you killed 10 of each yet?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You did a bang-up job of clearing out those Raptors, friend!
